text:
jess: quick UX check — the playground run-history currently shows full arg blobs and it's noisy. thinking: show compact summary (type + size) and a small toggle to expand a mini-json viewer. omar: yes. hover-only is bad on touch. toggle should be a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. label needs to be tiny (<=10 chars). mira: copy options: "Preview", "Inspect", "Value". i prefer "Preview". avoid punctuation. qa-bot: QA checklist suggestion: keyboard open/close, screen reader announce, escape restores focus, mobile tap target >=44px, virtualization tests. omar: accessibility details: when opened move focus to the panel heading (role=region or dialog with aria-modal=false). announce: "Expanded argument preview for ". do NOT trap focus; allow tabbing out. jess: visual idea: show inline hint like "object (3)" or "array (8)" and a chevron that toggles. animate opacity + max-height only to avoid layout jumps. mira: move copy-to-clipboard out of the preview into the row actions to avoid accidental clicks. Copy button should have aria-label: "Copy sample value for ". omar: pseudo markup to share with engineers: ```
\n items\n \n \n
\n
\n

Argument preview: items (array)

\n 
[...]
\n
\n``` jess: telemetry idea: emit event on expand. if usage < 1-2% hide under a menu for dense timelines. mira: localization note: keep label short (< 12 chars) and avoid punctuation-heavy phrases. some langs expand. design-bot: Created ticket PL-9999 "Run-history: compact arg summary + toggle" — https://go/redwood/PL-9999 jess: next steps: mira add copy + loc notes to PL-9999, omar add a11y checklist, qa-bot will add QA tests, i'll prototype the compact row. sync in 20. :thumbsup:
